name: star-field.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field.scss — MANIFEST for the Star Field experiment route
//  (shadow-scoped via ?inline): a fullscreen Three.js star-chart canvas
//  (Solar System → Milky Way → Andromeda). Split by surface into
//  star-field/ partials (imported below):
//    _view     :host + canvas + no-WebGL fallback
//    _loader   boot overlay (spinner, percent, stages, progress)
//    _hud      hint + aria-live + hover tooltip
//    _nav      navigator drawer (toggle, panel, groups, search)
//    _panel    dossier info panel + facts + prose + signature
//    _media    dossier media gallery
//    _actions  screenshot/overview button cluster
//    _mobile   <768px full-width sheets + compact HUD
//  Mobile-first: the drawer and panel become full-width sheets under 768px.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';
@import '../../core/sass/base/structure';

$_B_SF: 'sf';

// Top inset clearing the fixed app-nav chrome (logo + burger live at
// ~$space-lg + nav height) — every top-pinned overlay starts below it.
$_NAV_INSET: to-rem($space-4xl);

@import 'star-field/view';
@import 'star-field/loader';
@import 'star-field/hud';
@import 'star-field/nav';
@import 'star-field/panel';
@import 'star-field/media';
@import 'star-field/actions';
@import 'star-field/mobile';
